title: AI-Designed Looks for Custom Styles
changes: When you pick a free-form style for your video, the AI now designs a unique look for it. This covers the colors, fonts and overall feel of the scenes.
Videos in custom styles look more polished and match your chosen style better.

title: Picture Library and Urdu Voices
changes: New picture library. Find pictures and use them in your videos.
New photo scenes. Your videos can now show real photos, not only motion graphics.
You can now start a video from a topic. You do not need a document or pasted text.
New Urdu narration voices. Make videos with Urdu voice-over.
Pictures load more reliably. When a picture website is busy, the app waits and tries again, so fewer pictures go missing.
The studio preview no longer crashes when it plays audio.
The studio preview runs more smoothly while it plays.

title: First release of Explainer Studio
changes: Turn a PDF, Word file, web page, image or pasted text into a long YouTube explainer video.
AI writes the outline and the script for the level you choose, from Kindergarten to PhD. You can edit every step.
Free narration with natural voices, plus music, sound effects and captions with the right credits.
Many scene types: diagrams, charts, timelines, equations, quizzes and more, in several looks.
Brand kit with your logo, colours, intro, outro and watermark. Group videos into numbered series.
Each video comes with chapters, thumbnails and a ready YouTube description.
